card.name: Ruling out other organic causes
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'organic' or a named underlying disease, such as 'exclude other', 'absence of', 'possible' and 'presence of an', in diagnostic or contraindication wording about neurological or structural lesions.

modes.label: Exclude other causes
modes.description: Words like 'other' or 'potentially' after 'exclude', ahead of serious neurological conditions.
modes.example: exclude<< other>> potentially serious neurological conditions.

modes.label: Absence or presence of organic disease
modes.description: 'of', 'organic' or 'possible' in phrases about an organic lesion or pathology being present or absent.
modes.example: in the presence of an<< organic>> intracranial lesion such as pit

modes.label: Imaging wording
modes.description: Words within imaging descriptions, such as 'm' in Tc-99m, or 'occupying' in space occupying lesion.
modes.example: presence of a space<< occupying>> lesion of the brain

card.writes: It pushes toward the word 'organic' and nervous-system terms, as in 'organic' lesion or 'neurological' cause.
card.plain: It fires on the words leading into 'organic' or a structural cause, as when a label says to rule out other serious neurological disease.
